I’ll locate where prompt versions add internal tags, copy the caller’s dictionary before those additions, and add a regression test for dictionary reuse. I’ll follow the repository’s Python style skill.
`PromptVersion` adds internal entries directly to the supplied dictionary. The regression test already staged in the workspace reproduces the failure. I’ll preserve and extend it to verify that both versions retain their own templates and model configurations.
Fixed `PromptVersion` to copy caller-provided tags before adding internal entries, preventing mutation and configuration leaks between versions.

Extended the existing regression test to check unchanged caller tags and independent templates/model configurations.
